title: Hello world page
description:
Build the Next.js page at `/` so that it shows a single heading with the text `Hello, World!`. ### Rules & clarifications - The heading is an `

` element and its text is exactly `Hello, World!`, with the capital letters, the comma and the exclamation mark. - The page has no other heading. - Write the code in the `Page` component in `src/app/page.tsx`. The layout in `src/app/layout.tsx` already wraps the page in `` and ``; do not change it. - The tests check the content of the page, not its styling: no CSS is needed. - The rendered HTML has this structure: ```html

Hello, World!

``` ### Example Open the page → the heading `Hello, World!` is shown.
